title: Folk psychology is an empirical theory, open to revision

statements.text: The first step is to see that folk psychology is a theory, despite being applied to oneself and others and being overpoweringly familiar. Being a theory, how good it is is an empirical, not an a priori, question, and its obviousness will not protect it from revision or replacement if it is flawed. Even if it is in some degree built in, that does not guarantee its truth.

sources.quote: The crucial first step is to see that it is a theory
it is an empirical , not an a priori , question how good a theory in fact it is
